lines: Devang Mehta, an investor selling shareholder, sells up to 16,650 shares in the offer for sale, with proceeds up to ₹2.25 crore if all are sold.
Proceeds are up to ₹2.25 crore; employee-portion shares sell at a discount, so actual proceeds are slightly lower.
The money is in hand since 11 Mar 2026 (8 months ago), and shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago, which is recent.
Retained holding of ₹5.25 crore is an estimate at offer price; name verified in seller table, holdings found in one section only.
